Learn about proposed changes to Optional Practical Training (OPT)

Proposed changes to OPT, used by approximately 80% of physics international students to obtain temporary employment, would charge universities excessive fees.

APS urges the National Science Foundation to not incorporate proposed revisions into its final Guidance on Financial Assistance.

Read about an exceptional volunteer and member whose generosity is expanding opportunities in physics. Through decades of volunteer service and philanthropic support, she is helping strengthen the physics community and create opportunities for future generations.
